releaseNotes: Icons across the app are now clear, consistent icons instead of emojis
FGZ CMS now shows a message when an update is available, and you can install it right from that message
Game ID is now called Card No on every screen and in exported and backup files
FGZ CMS now opens maximized to fill the screen
The daily Telegram backup now runs at 8:45 PM, and the time can be changed on the Backup tab
